scripts.build: bun run generate:licenses && bun run --filter '*' build
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && bun run check:shaders
scripts.check:shaders: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/shader-conformance/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/shader-conformance/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path crates/shader-conformance/Cargo.toml
scripts.mutation: bun run mutation:ts && bun run mutation:rust:mutest
scripts.mutation:rust:mutest: bun scripts/run-mutest.ts pixel-color analysis-context advice-model advice-report advice-stats advice-damage-origins advice-detectors match-event-model match-event-defense match-event-offense spatial-refine match-event-layer temporal-confirm attack-info-vision input-vision hud-vision frame-meter meter-tracker video-analyzer wasm-bridge
scripts.mutation:ts: bun run mutation:ts:client && bun run mutation:ts:server-models
scripts.mutation:ts:server-models: stryker run stryker.server-models.config.mjs && bun scripts/check-stryker-results.ts reports/mutation/server-models.json
scripts.mutation:ts:server-repositories: stryker run stryker.server-repositories.config.mjs && bun scripts/check-stryker-results.ts reports/mutation/server-repositories.json
scripts.prepare:check: bun run generate:licenses && bun run --filter @fighter-notes/client build:wasm
scripts.watch:run: bun run generate:licenses && bun run --filter '*' --parallel watch:run
